judgment.rationale: The reporter's screenshot shows the Copilot-key chord Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 mapped to Ctrl (Right), but the mapping does not work. Open issue #35808 is the established tracker for Copilot-key remapping and already contains a matching report with the same source chord and Ctrl (Right) destination.
evidence: The issue identifies Keyboard Manager on PowerToys 0.100.2 and says a Right Ctrl remap does not work.
The reporter's screenshot shows Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 mapped to Ctrl (Right), which is the keyboard event sequence used by the Copilot key on affected devices.
Issue #35808 is open and tracks Keyboard Manager failing to remap the Copilot key.
A comment in #35808 reports the exact Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 to Ctrl (Right) mapping and says that mapping fails while mappings to non-modifier keys work.
The live timeline for #50496 has no linked issue or pull request, and the issue has no assignee.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate response linking #35808 and keep further reproduction details in that canonical tracker.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate PowerToys fix assessment for #50496 would duplicate the active investigation in #35808, which covers the same Copilot-key chord to standalone Right Ctrl behavior.

issue_context.summary: A Lenovo laptop user reports that Keyboard Manager does not make the Copilot-key chord behave as Right Ctrl. Their screenshot shows Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 mapped to Ctrl (Right), matching an existing open Keyboard Manager tracker.
known_information: The report is for PowerToys 0.100.2 installed through auto-update.
The affected module is Keyboard Manager.
The screenshot shows Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 mapped to Ctrl (Right), and the mapping is enabled.
The reporter uses Windows 11 Home 25H2, build 26200.9445, on a Lenovo XiaoXinPro 16c IAH10.
The reporter attempted to install PowerToys 0.101.2362.0; the posted installer excerpt says an existing per-user 0.100.2 installation prevented that installer path.
No expected/actual behavior details, diagnostic ZIP, assignee, or linked item are present on #50496.
Issue #35808 remains open and contains a matching report of the same Copilot-key chord failing when mapped to Ctrl (Right).
inferences: The physical key shown by the mapping is likely the laptop's Copilot key rather than a standalone F23 key.
Because #35808 contains the same source chord, destination, and failure, #50496 is very likely another instance of that tracked behavior.
The separate installer message does not establish a Keyboard Manager root cause and should not create a competing remapping investigation.
issue_context.analysis: The follow-up screenshot resolves the otherwise vague phrase 'right ctrl key map' by showing the exact source and destination. Live duplicate search found a materially identical report in #35808, including the same Win+Shift+F23 sequence and failed Ctrl (Right) output. Consolidation is more useful than requesting generic diagnostics or proposing an independent fix from this sparse report.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue body, both comments, labels, assignees, attachment, update time, and timeline.
Confirmed that the attached screenshot shows Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 mapped to Ctrl (Right).
Searched open and closed PowerToys issues and pull requests for Right Ctrl, Copilot-key, and F23 remapping reports.
Read the active canonical issue #35808 and confirmed it contains the same mapping and failure.
Compared narrower related reports #45453, #44866, #35009, and #48077; those add application-, layout-, or feature-specific scope not stated in #50496.

comment.body: Thanks for adding the mapping screenshot. The Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23 Copilot-key chord failing when mapped to Ctrl (Right) is already tracked in #35808, including a report with the same source chord and destination. Please follow that issue and add any model-specific reproduction results there so the investigation stays consolidated. The 0.101.2362.0 installer message is a separate per-user upgrade problem; if upgrading remains blocked after following the installer guidance, please report that separately with the complete installer log.
